versions.content: For each RunnableEntity which is subject to variability and which variability shall be implemented the RTE Configuration Header File shall contain one definition of a Condition Value #define Rte_VPCon_<cts>_<re>_<resl> <value> where <cts> is the component type symbol of the AtomicSwComponentType , <re> is the short name of the RunnableEntity <resl> is the shortLabel of the RunnableEntity 's VariationPoint containing the reference element (e.g. a VariableAccess ) to the PortInterface element, <value> is the evaluated value of the ConditionByFormula of the Variation- Point defining the variant existence of the RunnableEntity in table 4.20.
